title: Elisa Baldazzi
text:
PhD Student
Department of Economics University of Bologna
I am a third-year PhD student in Economics (interdisciplinary PhD in Public Governance, Management and Policy) at University of Bologna under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Pietro Biroli (University of Bologna) and Prof. Dr. Marina Della Giusta (University of Turin). I have been a visiting researcher at London School of Economics, at the Department of Social Policy, under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Almudena Sevilla and at the WISPPRH.
My research lies in applied microeconomics, gender economics and economics of education. If you want to get in touch, please don’t hesitate to contact me.
